fightLines.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Sophia Tang. Bus driver. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Photo album, Trail compass, Dispatcher's headset, Notebook, Seed packet. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
You remember the Sling at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.

🔥 The fire settles. Sidney has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once.
